::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/credit_units/{unit}/overdraft_limits"}
#docs
The unit's own limit is `overdraft_limit` on the credit unit. Needs `credits:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `unit` | `string` | **yes** | The credit unit's id: the slug you chose. |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | `string` | no | Only plan or only customer overrides. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size, 1 to 1000. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_overdraft_limit`. One of `credit_overdraft_limit`. |
| `data.unit` | `string` | The credit unit. |
| `data.level` | `string` | The credit overdraft limit's level. One of `unit`, `plan`, `customer`. |
| `data.product` | `string` | The plan, for a plan override. |
| `data.product_name` | `string` | The plan's name. |
| `data.customer` | `string` | cus_…, for a customer override. |
| `data.customer_name` | `string` | The customer's name. |
| `data.overdraft_limit` | `integer` | In the unit's smallest step. |
| `data.overdraft_limit_decimal` | `string` | In whole units, for example `2.5`. |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the credit overdraft limit was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The overrides. |
| `404` | No such credit unit. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_units/seat/overdraft_limits?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
